title: Bank Deposit Late-Delivery Refund Share Schedule by Days Late
content:
Under the Bank Deposit on-time promise, the share of the transfer fee refunded for late delivery follows how many days late the transfer was, counted in calendar days up to its deposit date.

## Schedule

| Days late | Late-delivery refund share |
|---|---|
| 6 or more (the long-delay count reached) | 70 percent of the transfer fee |
| 3, 4 or 5 (the mid-delay count of 3 reached, the long-delay count of 6 not reached) | 45 percent of the transfer fee |
| fewer than 3 | not affected by this schedule |

Stated as a clause: a transfer whose days late reach 6 takes the long-delay share of 70 percent; one whose days late reach 3 but fall short of 6 takes the mid-delay share of 45 percent; a late transfer whose days late are fewer than 3 is not affected by this schedule.

## Both sides of each threshold

| Days late | Share under this schedule |
|---|---|
| 7 | 70 percent |
| 6 | 70 percent |
| 5 | 45 percent |
| 3 | 45 percent |
| 2 | not affected |

## Basis questions

**Is the share 45 percent for a transfer exactly 3 days late?** Yes. Reaching the count of 3 is enough; it does not need to be exceeded.

**Is a transfer 6 days late in the 45 percent row or the 70 percent row?** The 70 percent row; 6 reaches the long-delay count.

**Does the share act on the card funding fee?** No. It is a share of the transfer fee.
